_why: commons constants for every branch (PROGRAMME_GOVERNANCE 3.3, KIT_PLAN 8.2). station.json (station-only) overrides any key by deep merge; lists are replaced, except hooks.<Event> which is a UNION (commons modules + station modules). On main there is no station.json and the station name is 'core'. No hook or check hard-codes a value that lives here.
name: core

knobs._why: programme size per station (KIT_PLAN 8.3); main = standard/L/small

claude_md_budget._why: bytes per gov knob (GOV 4.1); the commons CLAUDE.md is <= core so a station's .claude/rules/station.md fits under standard

gov._why: every governance constant; no hook or check hard-codes one (GOV 3.3)
gov.hedge_regex: not mine|pre-existing|unexplained|not explained|(?<![\w-])noted(?![\w-])|for the next author|presumed|TODO later

hooks._why: station_dispatch.py runs these modules in-process on PreToolUse (decision 4). Bare name -> .claude/hooks/<name>.py; 'station/<name>' -> .claude/hooks/station/<name>.py. station.json hooks.PreToolUse is UNIONED with this list, never replaces it.
